# Office Toolkit — Complete Reference

Office Toolkit is a free, browser-first suite of tools for e-signatures and invoices. No account, no uploads, no data harvesting — your work stays on your device. All processing happens locally in the browser using WebAssembly and modern web APIs.

## Tools — Detailed

### E-Signature Maker
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/e-signature-maker

**What it does**: Create a signature by drawing, typing, or uploading an image. Place it on any PDF document. Download as a transparent PNG (signature only) or a signed PDF (signature embedded on the document).

**Features**:
- Draw signature with mouse/touch/stylus
- Type signature with professional fonts
- Upload signature image (PNG, JPG, WebP)
- Place signature on any page of a PDF
- Resize and reposition freely
- Download transparent PNG or signed PDF
- Works offline after first load

**FAQ**:
- **Is it really free?** Yes, no limits, no payment.
- **Do you store my PDF?** No. The PDF never leaves your browser.
- **Can I use this for legal documents?** Meets e-signature standards for most everyday use. Consult a lawyer for high-stakes matters.
- **What browsers are supported?** Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge — any modern browser.

---

### Invoice Generator
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/invoice-generator

**What it does**: Create professional invoices with line items, tax calculations, logo, and multiple currencies. Export as PDF, PNG, or JPG.

**Features**:
- Add unlimited line items with description, quantity, rate
- Automatic tax calculation (GST, VAT, custom rates)
- Upload company logo
- Multiple currencies (INR, USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, etc.)
- GST-compliant format with HSN codes, CGST/SGST/IGST
- Live preview as you type
- Export as PDF, PNG, or JPG
- Duplicate and edit previous invoices (stored locally in browser)

**FAQ**:
- **Is the invoice generator free?** Yes, 100% free.
- **Does it support Indian GST?** Yes, with HSN codes and proper tax breakdown.
- **Can I save invoices?** They stay in your browser's localStorage — only you can see them.
- **What currencies?** 15+ currencies including INR, USD, EUR, GBP.

---

### Sign PDF Online
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-pdf
**Features**: Upload PDF → add signature → download signed PDF. No account, no upload to server.

### Sign Word Document
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-word
**Features**: Upload .docx → place signature → download signed PDF. Original .docx unchanged.

### Sign Excel File
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-excel
**Features**: Sign .xlsx files without modifying the data. Export signed PDF.

### Sign Contracts
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-contracts
**Features**: Multi-party signatures, date fields on each page, party names, download PDF.

### Sign Offer Letter
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/esignature-for-offer-letter
**Features**: Company + candidate signatures, role details, start date, download PDF.

### GST Invoice Generator
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/gst-invoice-generator
**Features**: GST format, HSN codes, taxable value, CGST/SGST/IGST, PDF export.

### Invoice Format in Excel
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/invoice-format-excel
**Features**: Free .xlsx template, auto-calculating totals, GST column, reusable.

### Invoice Format in Word
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/invoice-format-word
**Features**: Free .docx template, logo placeholder, item table, GST, export PDF.

### Freelancer Invoice Generator
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/invoice-for-freelancers
**Features**: Project-based billing, payment terms, client details, due dates, PDF export.

### Quotation Format
**URL**: https://office-toolkit.vercel.app/tools/quotation-format
**Features**: Quotation template, validity period, proforma invoice support, PDF export.

## Key Facts (Expanded)

- **Cost**: All tools are free forever. No freemium, no trial, no upsell.
- **Privacy**: Zero data leaves your browser. No analytics on document content. No server-side processing.
- **Technology**: React + TypeScript + Vite. PDF handling via pdf-lib and PDF.js (WebAssembly). Signatures via Canvas API.
- **Offline**: After first visit, tools work offline (Service Worker caches assets).
- **Export formats**:
  - Invoices: PDF (print-ready), PNG (image), JPG (compressed)
  - Signatures: Transparent PNG, Signed PDF
- **Currencies**: INR, USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, SGD, CHF, JPY, CNY, and more
- **Languages**: English (UI), content in English
- **Browser support**: Chrome 90+, Firefox 88+, Safari 14+, Edge 90+

## Comparison: Free vs Paid Signature Tools

| Aspect | Office Toolkit (Free) | Typical Paid Tools |
|--------|----------------------|-------------------|
| Cost | $0 forever | $10–$40/month |
| Signup required | No | Yes |
| Document upload | Never (local only) | Required (cloud storage) |
| PDF signing | Yes | Yes |
| Signature types | Draw, type, upload | Draw, type, upload |
| Export formats | PNG, PDF | PNG, PDF, sometimes DOCX |
| Audit trail | No (local only) | Often included |
| Legal compliance | Basic e-signature standards | Often ESIGN/eIDAS certified |
| Team features | No | Yes (workflows, templates) |

**Honest assessment**: Office Toolkit is ideal for individuals and small teams who need occasional signatures without recurring costs or privacy concerns. For high-volume workflows, audit trails, or regulatory compliance (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 11, eIDAS qualified signatures), a paid service with certified audit trails is more appropriate.

## Comparison: Free vs Paid Invoice Tools

| Aspect | Office Toolkit (Free) | Typical Paid Tools |
|--------|----------------------|-------------------|
| Cost | $0 forever | $15–$50/month |
| Signup required | No | Yes |
| GST/VAT support | Yes (Indian GST, custom rates) | Yes |
| Multi-currency | Yes (15+) | Yes |
| Logo upload | Yes | Yes |
| Recurring invoices | No (manual duplicate) | Yes |
| Payment integration | No | Often (Stripe, PayPal) |
| Client portal | No | Sometimes |
| Data export | PDF, PNG, JPG | PDF, CSV, API |

**Honest assessment**: Office Toolkit covers the core invoice creation needs — professional look, tax compliance, multiple currencies — without subscription fees. If you need recurring billing, payment links, client portals, or accounting integrations, a paid invoicing platform is better suited.
